prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: approval picture for the Rakky Ride rider Services page.
Primary request: one polished complete portrait mobile screen, logical 390 x 844, flat front-on screenshot, no device frame. Match a compact white-forward ride-hailing app with forest green actions, pale mint cards, subtle silver borders, charcoal text and muted gray-green captions. Very small restrained typography: header 15px, card titles 14–15px, descriptions 13px, action labels 13–14px. Utility glyphs 16–18px within 44px touch targets. No large headline, no dense paragraph, no big artwork. Slightly rounded rectangular cards, not bubbly oversized UI.
Layout:
Small normal status bar at top. A compact header with circular pale silver back arrow at left and "Our services" as modest 15px text, thin divider. Below header a small muted sentence "Choose your next move." with 20px horizontal margins.
First card: full-width pale mint Ride card, about 155 logical px high. Upper portion left title "Ride" and caption "Everyday trips across Lagos." On right a SMALL clean stylized 3D green compact car, 64px wide, rounded toy-like professional asset with silver wheels and dark windows, not photorealistic. Bottom a full-width solid forest green 44px button "Book a ride" with small right arrow and white text.
Below with 12px gap a TWO COLUMN row of compact white service cards with subtle silver borders, each around 175px tall. Both use identical alignment: small 44px stylized 3D object above title, 14px title, short 13px description, bottom small green action with right arrow in a 44px tap row.
Left card: clean small stylized 3D tan cardboard parcel with simple tape and no text, title "Courier", description "Send a sealed parcel.", action "Send a package".
Right card: clean small stylized 3D white calendar with green top, plain calendar squares and a small clock detail (no illegible date lettering), title "Schedule a ride", description "Plan your pickup time.", action "Schedule".
Below a separate lower-emphasis full-width white bordered membership row about 90px high. Left small green plus symbol inside 36px pale mint rounded square. Middle exact title "Rakky Ride Plus" 14px, caption "Explore membership benefits." 13px. Below caption a small green action "View benefits". Right small gray chevron. Do not claim discounts, subscription price, or paid membership status.
Leave calm white breathing space below. At the very bottom above the home indicator, a compact muted caption "Rides and deliveries, in one place." Avoid adding a bottom navigation bar.
Artwork style: clean 3D not super realistic, soft matte materials, carefully placed in their small areas, consistent small lighting/shadows, no people, no giant hero illustration. All interface remains crisp flat UI.
Constraints: only these existing four services. No maps on this service hub. No payment information, user names, location coordinates, balances, promotions, badges, extra menu options, new service categories, or invented functionality. All text exactly as specified, comfortably readable, no clipping. One screen only, no surrounding presentation labels.

Use case: ui-mockup
Edit target: this Rakky Ride Services mobile screen.
Refine only the scale to make it noticeably more compact, preserving the exact layout hierarchy, all text, all four services, green-white-mint palette, and the same clean stylized 3D objects.
The car is too big: shrink it to HALF its current width and height, keep it aligned at right in the Ride card. The parcel and calendar are too big: shrink each to HALF its current width and height, keep each near the top left of its half-width card. Keep plenty of space around those small objects, do not replace the freed space with more artwork. Make the Ride card about 150 logical pixels high instead of 190; make the Courier/Schedule cards about 170 logical pixels tall instead of 230. Make Ride and Services heading text smaller: 15px on the 390px-wide logical screen. Titles in all cards 14px, descriptions 13px. Maintain 44px action rows. Forest green Book a ride button must be a solid fill without gradients and use a smaller centered 14px label with a small arrow. Plus badge should be only 32px with a 16px plus symbol. Move the Plus row up to follow the shorter cards. Keep the footer caption at the bottom with calm whitespace above it. No new wording, no cropping, no additional features. Same one complete flat portrait screen and exact readable text.
